template_data.headline_html: Five things to check before you sign.

items.title: Workshare percentage
items.sub: A vague number is not a commitment — get the exact split in writing

items.title: Customer relationship ownership
items.sub: If the prime controls all agency contact, you lose visibility when work shifts

items.title: Exclusivity clauses
items.sub: Some primes restrict you from pursuing the same opportunity independently

items.title: Non-compete scope
items.sub: Broad clauses can freeze you out of an entire agency for years

items.title: Performance obligations
items.sub: Undefined deliverables mean shared blame for delays you didn't cause
